en.headline: Tung Chung Line trains end early tonight for extension track works
en.dek: Services between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay stations conclude around 11pm on Saturday so engineers can install a critical turnout, with free shuttle buses provided afterwards.
body: The MTR Corporation said train services between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay stations on the Tung Chung Line will end earlier than usual at around 11pm on Saturday to allow critical turnout installation works for the Tung Chung Line Extension.

According to the operator, the last train from Tung Chung to Hong Kong departs at 23:02, the last from Hong Kong to Tung Chung at 23:07, and the last from Sunny Bay to Tung Chung at 23:29. Services between Sunny Bay and Hong Kong stations continue as normal.

Free shuttle buses will run between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay stations until the regular end of service to assist affected passengers. The MTR said additional staff and signs would be deployed at stations that night.

The corporation advised passengers to check last-train times and plan journeys in advance. It said normal service is expected to resume from the first train on Sunday once the works and pre-service testing are completed.

zh.headline: 東涌綫往來東涌及欣澳站列車今晚提早約11時完結
zh.dek: 港鐵為配合東涌綫延綫關鍵波口安裝工程，周六晚上往來東涌站及欣澳站服務約於晚上11時完結，其後安排免費接駁巴士。
body: 港鐵公司表示，為進行東涌綫延綫東涌東段第三次關鍵波口安裝工序，周六晚上往來東涌站及欣澳站的列車服務將提早於晚上約11時完結。
港鐵指，東涌站往香港站尾班車開出時間為晚上11時02分，香港站往東涌站為晚上11時07分，欣澳站往東涌站為晚上11時29分。往來欣澳站及香港站的服務則維持正常。
港鐵會安排免費接駁巴士往來東涌站及欣澳站，直至正常收車時間，以協助受影響乘客。港鐵表示當晚會在車站加派人手及增設指示。
港鐵呼籲乘客留意尾班車時間並預先計劃行程。公司表示會盡力確保工程順利進行，讓服務於翌日頭班車起恢復正常。
